messages.content: Who is the best singer in Jazz

function.name: search_music_instrument_players
function.description: Searches for top music instrument players in a specified music genre. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument.description: The type of musical instrument, e.g. trumpet

message.content: The title of “best” jazz singer can vary depending on personal taste and criteria (vocal technique, influence, innovation). Many consider **Ella Fitzgerald** one of the greatest due to her impeccable pitch, scat mastery, and timeless recordings. Other iconic figures include **Billie Holiday**, known for emotional depth; **Sarah Vaughan**, celebrated for vocal range; and contemporary legends like **Cassandra Wilson** or **Esperanza Spalding** who blend tradition with modernity. Each artist brings unique strengths, so the “best” often reflects individual preference.
message.reasoning: User asks "Who is the best singer in Jazz". We need to respond with an answer. There's no tool needed. Just give a response. Probably mention some well-known jazz singers like Ella Fitzgerald, Billie Holiday, etc. Provide a short answer.
